summary: A clickable settings-style row that acts like a button.
description: A button custom element used for navigating between sub-pages or opening dialogs, styled as a box row with an optional icon/description and a trailing nav arrow.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Label for the button. Inherited from MozBoxBase (toolkit/content/widgets/lit-utils.mjs).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Descriptive text for the button. Inherited from MozBoxBase.

attributes.name: iconSrc
attributes.description: The src for an optional icon shown next to the label. Inherited from MozBoxBase.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Whether or not the button is disabled.

attributes.name: accesskey
attributes.description: Key used for keyboard access (property name accessKey, mapped to the accesskey attribute).

attributes.name: parentDisabled
attributes.description: Disabled by the parent's state (internal, see MozBoxBase/MozBaseInputElement plumbing).

cssProperties.name: --box-button-background-color
cssProperties.description: Background color of the button row.

cssProperties.name: --box-button-text-color
cssProperties.description: Text color of the button row.
